name: Transport Request Intake Lite
description: Free n8n workflow for normalizing a simple transport request and validating required fields.

setup: "Webhook" (webhook) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.
Provide run inputs: body, query, headers.

hints: The original started from an inbound webhook (POST /transport-intake-lite). Run it with `cdecli workflow run <slug> --ver <version> -d '{"body": {...}}'` or through the workflow API.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
